horoscope: Tensions can be highly stimulating, but they can ramp up quickly today with a Sun-Mars square, dear Aries. Assertive and direct is one thing, but impatience can lead to abruptness with this transit. Restlessness may lead you to seek instant gratification, so it’s best to identify the root cause of your dissatisfaction instead of giving in to a random or sudden desire. Your love life or affections can be exciting but tumultuous, and perhaps a bit of a rollercoaster ride with Mars in your solar fifth house. With today's Sun-Mars square, your judgment could be temporarily impaired, especially around finances and love, even if you feel quite confident. Avoid taking risks, especially with money. Let things calm down before making important conclusions or decisions. It’s best not to move forward too quickly. However, with some moderation, creative projects might benefit from the passion of the day, or you might discover interesting ways to add a little spice to a relationship or friendship.

There can be some inner unrest to deal with today, dear Taurus, as passions run high. The Sun forms a square with Mars, and sudden urges and desires may be more about inner unrest rather than inner truth. Take more time to reach conclusions, and if you feel caught in the middle of an argument, try to back out as gracefully as possible, as it's likely to be a no-win situation. Emotional ups and downs can be quite extreme today, although for the most part, you could be feeling optimistic. Don't be surprised if someone doubts you now, however, or creates some opposition. A partner may see things entirely differently than you do. Indecisiveness can leave you torn between two options, and this "either/or" energy can feel uncomfortable right now. If you strive to enjoy the moment without borrowing from the future, however, you can have some fun today. Some competitiveness can be stimulating and may lead to positive change and improvement if you channel it productively rather than waste it on bickering or impatience.

The Sun in your sector of work, health, and habits is doing battle with bodies in your sector of communications and personal interests these days, dear Gemini, and today is no exception. A Sun-Mars square can leave you feeling innerly conflicted or arguing with others—or a bit of both! Watch for impatient communications and moves. Before voicing your unsatisfied desires, see if the feeling passes, particularly if the urges come on very suddenly. In particular, try not to make rash decisions based solely on today's events. If people aren't catching on to your point of view, try waiting it out and resolve to present the same ideas later. You can be on edge, especially if you have so much to do that you don't know where to begin. The temptation is to overdo it now, but it benefits no one. However, you may decide to ride the competitive energy and use it to fix problems or areas of your life that have gotten out of hand.

Watch for impulsiveness today as the Sun and Mars form a square aspect, dear Cancer. If an urge comes on suddenly, it may be best to wait and see if it passes before indulging it. Under this influence, foresight may be a little lacking temporarily. Your attention turns to ambitions around resources (including money), and these seem to clash with personal enjoyment, a romantic venture, or fulfilling your desires. Another possibility is that you feel others aren't treating you for what you’re worth, or for what you deserve! You may be more sensitive than usual to how others value you. Keep in mind that balanced attention to practical matters now brings rewards later. While the drive to make more money or to feel more secure can be strong, try not to push yourself too hard, or you’re likely to meet some resistance now. Competitive or frustrated feelings can challenge you to make meaningful changes and improvements.

With the Sun and Mars forming a challenging square aspect today, dear Leo, potential pitfalls of the day lie in impatience, rushing or pushing things, and ego issues. With Mars in your sign, your inner unrest can be so palpable that others sense it even if you attempt to hide it. This can contribute to a sense that everyone around you is on edge. Family or others close to you may not see things the same way you do right now, and it's best not to take it personally, though it's challenging. Wait until a more "in sync" day for meaningful conversations. Being direct and honest in your dealings is excellent, but today requires extra sensitivity, since you may step on others' toes in pursuit of your goals, even if unintentionally. Watch for wanting too much too soon today. While there is strong energy for getting things done, impatience can trip you up, so aim to pour excess energy into something genuinely useful to you.

Complicated feelings can easily bubble up to the surface today, dear Virgo, and seemingly out of nowhere. Anger or resentment you have buried or brushed aside tends to emerge with today's Sun-Mars square, and while the feelings can be confusing at first and you should absolutely deal with them, don't let them control you either. It's all too easy to get distracted today and put your faith in impractical pursuits. Try not to stack up a slew of new projects that you later don't have enough time or energy to complete. The key to competence today is weeding out useless information and focusing on what truly matters. Today’s aspects tend to stir the pot, and patience is necessary, as pushing may only serve to increase resistance. Tap into your inner courage and find your passion, then think about ways to express it all. Drawing upon your creative power and using it to make important changes may come more easily later today.

With the Sun and Mars forming a tense square today, dear Libra, you might feel that others are nitpicking or meddling too much in your affairs. This transit can highlight tensions and unfulfilled desires. Focusing on practical matters may be challenging today. If you can, try not to schedule important appointments or meetings for today, and take a break. Also, avoid pushing something that you can't change, allowing for unexpected changes. You may tend to butt heads over issues that have been frustrating you. You can be feeling defensive with others or especially anxious to move a project forward, but it's difficult to find the support you need. Some competitiveness can motivate you to do your best or take care of business. If so, it's a great time to tap into it. Pacing yourself is important.

Today’s Sun-Mars square can produce a feeling of urgency to fulfill your desires, dear Scorpio. Petty disagreements can very easily escalate into full-blown arguments or stand-offs today. You might easily become offended if others are not recognizing your competence or needs. Rushing and impatience tend to exacerbate or create problems now. You may feel that you need to fight to get your needs met or to be heard. As much as you want to do it all right now, it’s important to pace yourself. Big ideas need more definition before you put them into action. Rushing and impatience tend to cause the most problems now, and you may be in the position of mediator. With today's transits, instant results may not appear, and won't be gratifying even if they do.

Tension can arise today if you have too much on your plate or feel the need to rush things, dear Sagittarius. Try tackling things one at a time rather than wearing yourself out. With a Sun-Mars square, you might be overconfident and take on more challenges than you can reasonably manage. You might have an unexpected adventure or detour from your usual routine. Philosophical debates can quickly escalate into arguments or veer into personal territory right now, so watch out for wasting energy on them. Your appetite for pleasure or for instant gratification may be enormous, but the results are not going to satisfy you in the long term. The Sun-Mars square active today works behind the scenes in your chart, obscuring the real source of your discontent. However, if you can channel excess energy into a constructive project, you might get a chance to learn a little more about desires that seem to emerge out of nowhere. Or you might tap into your courage to do something entirely different and enjoy a new experience.

With the Sun and Mars forming a square today, dear Capricorn, energies tend to rile you up. Try to channel this energy positively, as you are quite hungry for emotional stimulation. However, it’s also a good idea to observe what’s bringing you to the point of frustration. Disagreements now tend to stem from underlying competitiveness. Boundaries and commitments can be issues. It’s not an ideal time for financial planning or solid decision-making since the tendency is to jump into or out of something without thinking. It’s a good idea to watch for impatience and hot-headedness today, and aim to learn about yourself and your needs. It's all too easy to confuse drama with attention or happiness in your social or love life with this transit. It can bring out an immature part of you if you're not careful, and restlessness or impatience can lead to errors or unnecessary complications. Your best bet is to avoid letting impulses take control.

Relationships today are dynamic and stimulating, dear Aquarius, but not necessarily stable, with a Sun-Mars square active. Although directness and forthrightness are generally favored, you might be annoyed by others' seeming aggressiveness right now. Others may be vying for your attention right now, but this can be disruptive. A good strategy for today's tensions would be to channel excess energy into something productive and worth your attention. You need creative outlets! You can feel quite motivated if you set aside impatience or anger. If it's not a race, remind yourself of that fact today. Haste makes waste today, and you may need to take special care in your dealings, particularly with a person in authority, a colleague, and a partner, where abrasiveness can be an issue.

Energy for work or daily routines can be especially dynamic today, dear Pisces, and you might use it constructively by directing your attention to your special projects or health endeavors. You seem to have energy to spare. However, if you don’t take an active role today, the day's energies can easily turn on you, and you might find yourself impatient with others or feeling that people grate on your nerves. You could also be missing important steps or pushing yourself unnecessarily. Try not to rush things. While you’re busy trying to see the big picture, interruptions and annoying details frequently surface today. Today’s Sun-Mars square can stir restlessness as you want to expand your horizons and feel compelled to stick to your routines. You can’t do it all, so aim to pace yourself.
